subject: Co-bundling Observify OTLP adapter with Redwood — certification & go-to-market
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@observify.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: alliances@datadog.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Observify x Redwood — OTLP adapter co-bundle request

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking a look at this. I'm Sara (Head of Partnerships at Observify). We build a lightweight OTLP proxy and adapter used by several large edge SaaS customers to normalize telemetry and reduce cardinality before forwarding to backends (Datadog, Grafana, others). A few of our mutual customers asked whether the adapter can be offered as a co-bundled integration with Redwood so they can purchase Observify + Redwood together via reseller/co-sell flows.

High-level asks from our side:
- Certification path to be listed in the Redwood Partner Catalog (technical and security checks).
- A mutual action plan (MAP) for a pilot (integration, joint demo, co-marketing).
- Guidance on commercial packaging and potential co-sell margins / discounting.

We'd love to run a short technical review with your integrations team and share our compliance pack. CC'ing Datadog Alliances since they will be part of the downstream support story for customers.

Attached: Observify one-pager and sample adapter manifest (ZIP) — will follow up with SOC2 summary.

Next step: are you available for a 30-min sync Wed or Thu?

Thanks,
Sara Khan
Head of Partnerships, Observify
sara.khan@observify.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@observify.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Observify x Redwood — OTLP adapter co-bundle request

Sara — thanks for the intro and context.

We'd be interested in exploring this. A couple of practical asks from our side to scope the pilot and certification sprint:
1) Technical checklist: sample adapter runtime requirements, supported protocols, expected throughput, CPU/memory footprint, and a simple test plan we can run in our sandbox (p95 journal).
2) Security/compliance artifacts: SOC 2 summary, data handling and retention policy, encryption at rest/in transit notes.
3) Commercial: how do you envision reseller vs referral (revenue share %) and whether Observify has a marketplace SKU we can reference.

I’m attaching our partner onboarding checklist (short stub) so you can see the gating criteria for catalog listing. If you can share the SOC2 summary and the adapter manifest (or a GitHub link) before the call it'll speed things up.

We can do Wed 10:00am PT — I’ll put a 30-min placeholder and invite Laura (commercial lead) and Ben (partner engineering/commercial ops) to own follow-ups.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@observify.com>, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Observify x Redwood — OTLP adapter co-bundle request

Quick note from commercial ops: thanks for looping us in. A few commercial items to kick off so the MAP can be actionable:
- What is Observify's target pilot discount, and do you expect Redwood to invoice or to route via your procurement?
- Any existing reseller/partner agreement or MSA we should reference?
- We'll need a signed NDA/MSA for any revenue sharing conversation — I can circulate a standard partner addendum (DocuSign link below).

DocuSign (partner addendum draft): https://docusign.example/12345

If Observify prefers to have Redwood resell, we typically structure a 15–25% margin depending on commitments. If it's referral, we do a 10–15% backreferral credit. We can refine once we see expected ARR profile.

Ben Carter
Director, Partnerships Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@observify.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@observify.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Observify x Redwood — OTLP adapter co-bundle request

Thanks Ben / Irene — good questions. Answers below and attaching our compliance pack and adapter architecture diagram.

- Commercial: Observify is open to Redwood reselling for the pilot. Target pilot discount we can accept is 18% net to Observify; for longer-term we can discuss tiers based on committed customers (we typically tier at 3 named customers / $120k ARR).
- Legal: we have a standard reseller addendum and MSA. Procurement will review any redlines; looping them here.
- Technical: adapter is a 2-process container with optional TLS termination and supports OTLP/HTTP and gRPC. Typical footprint 0.5–1 vCPU and ~150–300MB RAM under steady state. We maintain a compatibility test matrix; GitHub link: https://github.com/observify/otlp-adapter (public repo with CI).

Attachments included: observify-soc2-summary.pdf, otlp-adapter-arch.png

On the certification flow: we propose a 3-week sprint — week 1: integration & smoke tests in Redwood sandbox; week 2: joint QA and perf runs; week 3: documentation/marketplace listing and joint demo.

We can sign the DocuSign you sent once legal confirms the addendum. For the call tomorrow 10:00am PT — confirmed.

Regards,
Sara Khan
From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@observify.com>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Observify x Redwood — OTLP adapter co-bundle request

Thanks team — good alignment from the call this morning. Short summary and owners so we have a single source of truth: 

- MAP / timeline: target certification sprint start 2027-07-05, go-to-market joint demo target 2027-07-26. (Owner: irene for orchestration)
- Tech onboarding: Observify to open a sandbox deploy runbook and access to the GitHub CI. (Owner: ben.carter to coordinate engineering pair)
- Security artifacts: Observify SOC2 summary received and validated by our security intake; follow-up questions will be tracked in the Drive folder. (Owner: laura.bennett for compliance)
- Commercial: Ben to circulate reseller addendum in DocuSign and capture pilot pricing (we'll default to 18% net if Observify signs pilot addendum). (Owner: ben.carter)
- Marketing: Tessa to draft a joint co-sell one-pager once catalog listing is confirmed. (Owner: tessa.morgan)

Next actions: Ben — please send the DocuSign link + pilot addendum by EOD so procurement/legal can start review. Sara — please drop the sandbox runbook and any perf test instructions into the shared Drive (link below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/observify-partner-pack

Attached: MAP-20270621.xlsx (draft mutual action plan)

Irene Choi
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
